caption: The drawing shows a piece of wooden furniture consisting of a desk with multiple drawers. The desk is constructed with four slender, turned legs and has a rectangular work surface. Above the main surface, there is an upper compartment featuring six small drawers arranged in two rows of three, each fitted with a small round white knob. Directly below the main surface, there is a long, shallow drawer with a white knob, partially pulled out. Below this drawer, there is a single larger, deeper drawer with a round brown knob. The wood is depicted in shades of brown, with the main structure and legs being a darker brown, while all drawer faces are a lighter yellowish-brown tone. The background is off-white without any additional objects or details.
title: Shaker Sewing Table
